_readme.about: Tradetron strategy export. Edit and re-import via the ASB Import button.
_readme.logic: To change a condition's logic, edit its "conditionJson" (the AST). The "conditionValue"/"conditionDisplay" text is regenerated from it on import.
_readme.legs: For a leg field that has a "*Json" (e.g. "strikeJson"), edit the JSON — its text form is regenerated on import. Fields with no "*Json" (e.g. "qty") are plain text: edit them directly.
_readme.structure: Add/remove/duplicate legs, conditions or sets by editing the arrays.
_readme.do_not: Do not add "*_id" foreign keys back. Lists referenced by id must be ones you own.

name: Stocklist ORB with pyramiding and Trail-SL
description:
Stocklist ORB Intraday Strategy with 3-Min Candle Open & Close Breakout and Entry Candle SL Guardrail

Strategy Notes:

----------------

1. Entry (Opening Range Breakout):

  • Underlying: |SwingStocksList_1| (NSE Equity).
  • Entry Window: Starts at 9:30 AM IST (after 15-min ORB 09:15–09:29 range completes).
  • Long Entry (Set 1): Buys ₹10,000 value when completed 3-min candle Open[-1] AND Close[-1] are BOTH strictly > 15-min ORB High.
  • Short Entry (Set 2): Sells ₹10,000 value when completed 3-min candle Open[-1] AND Close[-1] are BOTH strictly < 15-min ORB Low.

2. Exit Criteria & Stop Loss:

  • Long Exit (Set 1): Exits when completed 3-min Close[-1] <= 15-min ORB High OR Close[-1] <= Entry Candle Low[-1].
  • Short Exit (Set 2): Exits when completed 3-min Close[-1] >= 15-min ORB Low OR Close[-1] >= Entry Candle High[-1].
  • Universal Exit: Square off all open positions intraday at 3:15 PM (15:15 IST).
